features.description: Provision three independent OAuth authorizations on one account
acceptance_criteria: Checker refuses credential copies, account/workspace mismatch, unsafe paths and permissions without exposing secrets.
Provisioning creates independent file-backed homes and never copies interactive credentials.
features.notes: Offline fixture/mock tests pass, including device authorization; separate homes prepared with audited config, mission login completed. Cloud login remains pending; no auth copied.

features.description: Local mission home and one daemon refresh owner
acceptance_criteria: Mission controller, probes, quota reads and nested executors resolve the isolated mission home.
Measured daemon adapter uses one auth owner for concurrent local runs; unsupported CLI exec cannot silently bypass it.
features.notes: Controller/probe/nested routing implemented; native Codex 0.162.0 nine-client spike performed exactly one fake-token refresh. Race and protocol tests pass; live mission daemon inference returned MISSION_AUTH_OK. Production mission fleet activation pending integration.

acceptance_criteria: Transactionally acquire canonical credential before fetch and keep ownership through preflight/run/persist.
Cancellation/lease loss stops execution; failed persistence quarantines credential; no unsafe TTL takeover.
features.notes: Canonical nonexpiring Firestore ownership, heartbeat cancellation, durable rotation write-back and uncertain-termination quarantine implemented. Lease/cloud tests and race tests pass. Production SA read/add-version and datastore.user verified read-only; images not deployed.

acceptance_criteria: Focused Go, shell, boundary and lint checks pass; independent evaluator reviews criteria.
Two user-completed logins validate same account and independent credentials; cloud and local smoke tests pass before activation.
